name: Qutub Minar
descriptor: 73-metre red sandstone and marble victory tower in the Qutb complex.

identifyingCues.text: tapering fluted cylindrical shaft with projecting balconies
five distinct storeys separated by ornate balconies
alternating bands of red sandstone and buff sandstone with Quranic inscriptions

identity.text: Victory tower begun by Qutb ud-Din Aibak after the defeat of the last Hindu kingdom in Delhi.

visiting.text: Open daily sunrise to sunset. Interior staircase closed to visitors since 1981.

conditions.text: Flat site within the Qutb complex. Hot summers and monsoon rains similar to Delhi.

context.text: UNESCO World Heritage Site since 1993. The complex includes the Iron Pillar and the ruins of Quwwat-ul-Islam mosque.
